query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

rows.text: My old phone fell into the sea. I know my password, but the login screen wants a code from that phone. How can I get back in?
I still have my authentication app, but I cannot remember the secret I type before the code. What should I do?
I am leaving my employer and losing that mailbox. Can I keep my account but use my personal email for login?
I can sign in normally. How do I stop being asked for an extra code on future logins?
Keep what I already paid for, but make sure you do not bill me again next month. Where do I do that?
I want last week’s payment returned to my card. I am not asking to stop the subscription. How do I submit that?
Can I pay for a year at a time instead of getting a bill every month?
Our bookkeeper needs the PDF showing what we paid and the tax on it. Where is it?
My integration works for small batches but gets 429 when I launch many requests together. How should I change the client?
Sometimes a request just waits until my 30-second deadline expires. There is no 429. How do I diagnose it?
Every request says 401 even when I send only one. Which part of authentication should I check?
One customer action sometimes makes my webhook handler create two orders. How do I prevent the second side effect?
How can my endpoint tell whether an event really came from your service rather than somebody faking a POST?
I need a copy of all our records for analysis elsewhere, but leave the originals where they are. What is the process?
I want the account and its stored records gone permanently, not just a downloaded copy. Where do I request that?
I accidentally removed a file yesterday. Can I bring it back instead of recreating it?
How do I undo an accidental removal from the file list?
Where can finance get proof of a completed payment?
What prevents repeated notifications from causing repeated purchases?
Can I keep access until the end of this month without extending the plan?
